verdict.rationale: Productboard's REST API supports create/update/search across feedback, features, and other entities with cursor-based pagination for large result sets, which enables scripted bulk-style operations, and the MCP server lets AI agents update fields, add features to initiatives, etc. However, there is no documented dedicated batch/bulk endpoint or explicit multi-item transaction support — operations appear to be per-item, requiring manual iteration to achieve bulk effect. Missing for 10: explicit bulk create/update/delete endpoints, documented batch API, evidence of AI agents performing true multi-item bulk actions in one call.
